questions.stem: Which of the following statements regarding squamocolumnar junction is false?

options.label: A
options.text: The squamocolumnar junction everts outside with age under the influence of estrogen.

options.label: B
options.text: Endocervix is lined with squamous epithelium and ectocervix is lined with columnar epithelium.

options.label: D
options.text: Metaplastic cells in this transformation zone are prone to develop Cervical cancer.
